notes:
Top-line: mid-market analytics SaaS (B2B) evaluating Redwood as primary inference provider.
Contacts: Elena Markovic (Head of Product), Owen Reed (CTO), procurement lead Tomasz Kowalczyk.
Use-case specifics: embeddings-driven doc search + reranking for knowledge base, chat-based product assistant with personalization, model suggestions for recommendations.
Latency/throughput targets: p95 <= 250ms for chat in EU region; sustain ~200 concurrent active chat sessions during peak; embeddings batch throughput 10k vectors/hr.
Residency & regional routing: customer requires EU-only data residency for PII-derived prompts and embeddings. Primary region preference: eu-central (Frankfurt) with optional eu-west failover. Ask: can Redwood guarantee no token routing outside EU for resident profiles?
Multi-region tradeoffs discussed: client willing to accept slight increase in p95 (250->320ms) for cross-region fallback to reduce cold-start incidence and cost. They asked about routing policy granularity (per-tenant routing, per-route model pins) and deterministic region pinning.
Security/compliance: SOC2 in procurement checklist, prefer ISO27001; mandatory SSO SAML + audit logs + KMS integration for key custody. Retention controls: 30-day opt-in for prompt retention for eval; longer retention negotiated for production.
Hosted vs Dedicated path: starting with Hosted API to validate quality and collect latency profiles. If POC passes and procurement signs off on ARR estimate, move to Dedicated reserved capacity (1-2 GPU nodes initially). Key driver for Dedicated: predictable latency, EU residency SLA.
Pricing conversation notes: procurement prefers unit-based pricing during pilot; asked for committed pricing bands for Dedicated (12mo / 24mo). AE provided ballpark; to formalize in POC pricing doc (drive link).
Quotes: "Need a hard promise on EU-only processing for customers in our GDPR-bound segments" — Owen Reed.
POC scope: 2-week EU-hosted pilot with 3 sample routes (chat, embeddings, rerank), integration checklist, success metrics (p95 <= 250ms, embeddings recall delta < 2%), weekly syncs.
Risks: on-prem not viable due to cost — leaning to Dedicated in EU. Blocked by legal signoff on data residency answers and Dedicated SLA for multi-region failover.
Internal notes: SE Rahul to produce routing matrix options and latency/cost tradeoff sheet; AE Maya to circulate Dedicated pricing tiers and contract term templates.
